import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.scheduler_executor import run_executor

def main():
    # Executes at most one guarded op for Zephyr IV if allowed; otherwise plans only.
    out = run_executor(dry_run=False, only_agents=["Zephyr IV"])
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
